svg.title: Five-year cost of drying laundry
svg.desc: Estimated five-year cost of drying three loads a week (156 loads a year). Heat pump tumble dryer: £350 to buy plus about £54 a year, about £622 over five years; Dehumidifier + airer: £235 to buy plus about £81 a year, about £640 over five years; Condenser tumble dryer: £220 to buy plus about £139 a year, about £915 over five years. Purchase prices and running costs from Which? and retailer listings, October 2026; totals are our estimate.
svg.text: Buying price plus running costs, three loads a week
£350 to buy (cheapest good models, Which?), £54.32 a year
£234.90 (20L compressor), 26p a litre x 2 L a load
Our estimate from Which? running costs at 26.32p per kWh (dryers) and 26p per litre extracted (dehumidifier), and October 2026 prices.
New vented and condenser dryers will not be allowed onto the GB market from 19 January 2027. Prices and energy rates change.
